t_advice_summary_textbox.text: It is best to select gnomes related to a group of color baskets, until there are no longer mushrooms to collect. Then, I should switch to gnomes related to the other color basket.

vb_textbox.text: In this game there are eight gnomes, each associated with one of two basket colors: red or yellow. The red, pink, purple, and brown head gnomes are related to the red basket. The yellow, blue, orange, and green head gnomes are related to the yellow basket. Select one color basket and collect mushrooms until they run low. Then, switch to the other color basket and do the same.
